thread:
Maya: Evening all — final safety sweep before the midnight change window. Quick checklist: pinlist, canaries, fallback route, deploybot watchers, SLO watch. I’ll DM owners after.

Jon: +1. can someone confirm last-minute config flags? especially embed cache TTL.

Eli: embed TTL is 60s in prod. Verified on staging at 23:00, no regressions.

Maya: @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary pin for v2.14.3 for 30m?

deploy-bot: Scheduled pin: model v2.14.3 -> canary-pool, duration 1800s. Requested by Maya. :white_check_mark:

Jen: We plan 5% -> 25% -> 100% after 20m gating. Manual stop allowed at each step.

Paul: If latency > 1200ms or errors > 1% in canary, abort and rollback to v2.14.2. @sre-ops will run immediate rollback.

sre-ops: Copy. I’ll watch the dashboards and keep autoscaling tuned. Set min replicas to 4 for the window.

Jon: release notes — where are they? I can't find the doc.

Maya: posted earlier but here: https://internal/redwood/releases/v2.14.3-notes — includes known-issues and rollback playbook.

Jen: Short checklist for go-no-go: smoke tests green, integration tests ok, release notes posted, oncall pinged, deploybot pin confirmed.

Eli: Smoke tests run on staging:
```
smoke: OK
latency avg: 220ms
errors: 0/150
```
All green.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic started at 5% — monitoring hooks enabled: latency, errors, token-cost.

Maya: Reminder: remove debug logging if we’re green, and disable embedding sandbox before full rollout.

Paul: I’m on pager. Rollback steps if needed:
1) pin v2.14.2 to canary
2) trigger deploybot rollback command
3) open incident, notify legal if data-retention impacted

Jon: Small region note: this push is US-only. EU tenants remain on EU region patch scheduled next maintenance.

Maya: Correct. Change window covers US region only.

Jen: OK starting canary. @deploy-bot execute pin now.

deploy-bot: Action: pin v2.14.3 -> canary-pool (initiated by Jen). Status: success. :rocket:

sre-ops: Watch entries logged, dashboards pinned. I’ll call out immediately on anomalies.

Maya: Thanks team. If no abort by +25m we proceed with 25% -> 100% push. :thumbsup:

Paul: Noted — rollback playbook prepped and ready.

Jon: I’ll keep an eye on embedding latency for the first 5000 reqs.

Maya: Great — shouting out to everyone. Post any small failures here, keep messages short and tag oncall.

End of thread.
